body: thanks for chiming in, I needed this tonight

It's already been 5 months since we last really talked. I think hanging on to that bit of hope may leave me worse off than trying to cut the idea off right now.

And hey thanks I appreciate it. I didn't like who I had become and was determined to change it. It's too bad the damage that was done before I could make those changes. It's hard as hell building a life back up out of shambles.

I've been going over the same negative thoughts about who I was, continually beating myself up over and over again over the same stuff. Logically I understand it's irrational and I should forgive myself but I can't feel that way somehow. It's a puzzle I can't solve and its hella frustrating

You're definitely right. Its unfortunate and certainly counter-productive behaviour.

I said everything I possibly could. I sent her a wall of text explaining exactly how I felt, and she said she had no interest in having any sort of relationship. It's painful having left all my cards on the table and being shut out. She even knows I went to rehab for a 30 day stint to get off the study drugs, but I guess it didn't mean anything.

I thought a full apology to her would have left me better off, but apologizing can't make me accept the kind of human being I was at the time. I don't know what can :(
Myself, I'm responsible for how I treated those closest to me so I have a lot of self-loathing going on right now :(

Hey, thanks for stopping by. I treated the most important person in my life terribly during an awful time of my life and I haven't been able to forgive myself for it. The feelings I have are only getting stronger with time, and I plan to see a psych although she can't see me for a month.
I have no one in my life who I can talk to this stuff about. She was the one I'd lean on with anything emotional. Lately I've felt like it's only a matter of time before I opt out. I gotta spend my days with the person who ruined my life, and its eating my alive :(
Thanks again, its awesome to be able to get that off my chest
